connector.name: Warehouse MCP
connector.registryDescription: Production MCP server for Postgres, Oracle, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, DuckDB, MotherDuck.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package warehouse-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the kalehdoo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
env.description: Set to 'stdio' for desktop AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor). Defaults to 'http'.

env.name: WAREHOUSE_TYPE
env.description: Which warehouse to connect to. One of: postgres, oracle, redshift, snowflake, bigquery, duckdb. (DuckDB also handles MotherDuck via DUCKDB_PATH=md:<db>.)

env.name: MCP_API_KEYS
env.description: Comma-separated bearer keys with role and optional warehouse-role impersonation: 'key1:reader,key2:admin', 'key3:reader:set_role=alice'. Leave empty for stdio (OS process boundary is the trust boundary). Required for HTTP.

env.name: DUCKDB_PATH
env.description: DuckDB file path, ':memory:', or 'md:<database>' for MotherDuck. Required when WAREHOUSE_TYPE=duckdb.

env.name: MOTHERDUCK_TOKEN
env.description: MotherDuck service token. Required when DUCKDB_PATH starts with 'md:'.

env.name: PG_HOST
env.description: Postgres host. Required when WAREHOUSE_TYPE=postgres. (Use REDSHIFT_HOST for Redshift.)

env.name: ORACLE_CONNECT_STRING
env.description: Oracle Easy Connect (e.g. host:1521/SERVICE), TNS descriptor, or alias.

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT
env.description: Snowflake account identifier (e.g. xy12345.us-east-1). Required when WAREHOUSE_TYPE=snowflake.

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
env.description: Path to PKCS8 private key (.p8). Snowflake auth is key-pair only; password auth is not supported.

env.name: BIGQUERY_PROJECT
env.description: GCP project id. Required when WAREHOUSE_TYPE=bigquery.

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Path to BigQuery service-account JSON. Omit on GKE / Cloud Run with workload identity.

env.name: GUARDRAIL_PII_MASK
env.description: Set to 'on' to enable role-aware PII masking on result rows (emails, SSNs, phones, IPs, Luhn-validated CCs). Off by default.

env.name: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_RPM
env.description: Per-principal token-bucket rate limit on tool invocations. 0 = disabled. Recommend 60 for production.
